$comment: MCP directory manifest for the BrandAgent public read-only edge. Ready for submission to MCP directories (mcp.so / Smithery / PulseMCP). Publishing requires: (1) a public HTTPS URL via reverse proxy, (2) user's explicit release approval per red-line rules. transport: streamable HTTP (JSON responses, stateless).
name: brandagent-brand-tools
description: 让外部 AI 客户端（Claude、Cursor 等）读取你在 BrandAgent 工作台沉淀的品牌知识：品牌文档检索、权威产品事实、品牌规范与渠道规格。只读，无写入、无发布能力。

auth.$comment: static token from the BrandAgent workspace settings (future UI); or a BrandAgent Clerk session token (same identity as the web app)

tools.name: search_brand_documents
tools.description: Search active brand documents in the caller's workspace.

tools.name: get_brand_guidelines
tools.description: Get the active brand guideline version (tone, terms, positioning).

tools.name: get_channel_spec
tools.description: Get the active writing specification for a supported channel (length rules, tone, hashtags, forbidden patterns).

security_notes: Read-only by construction: write/export/publish tools are not registered in this process
Every credential is pinned to exactly one workspace; PostgreSQL RLS scopes every store access
Organization-bound tokens are rejected on this edge (personal workspaces only)
